title: On-Call Architectural/Engineering Services 2026
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary A/E services for transportation projects assigned by GCRTA engineering managers.
project_scope: On-call framework-style architectural and engineering support for transportation-related projects. The consultant is to prepare plans, specifications, cost estimates, construction duration estimates, and provide construction support services for projects assigned by the Engineering Project Manager. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, cost estimating, and planning/master planning. No specific structure, building size, span, or technical parameters are stated.
services: Architectural and engineering services; preparation of plans and specifications; cost estimating; construction duration estimating; construction support services; architecture; interior design/space planning; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering; planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad on-call A/E services without a defined structure or technically specific scope.
- Transportation sector is generally relevant, but no bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure is identified.
- Includes civil engineering, yet the notice is dominated by general multidisciplinary support.
- Appears similar to a framework/on-call procurement without technical specification, which is low priority for sbp.
- No evidence of large spans, structural innovation, sustainability focus, or architecturally demanding structures.
